CONTRACT_CODES.doc: The refusals of the contract-directory reader and of the links check (docs/contract-dir.md), by the code a refusal is printed with. A code is never reworded. The reader's own table: not a declaration, so no render carries it and it is not installed in the contract directory.

dirAbsent.doc: no contract directory was found, or the one named does not exist

text.en: No contract directory was found at {path}. Point --contract-dir, OMX_CONTRACT_PATH or pkg-config at it.

manifestAbsent.doc: a package directory holds no MANIFEST.json

text.en: The package directory {path} has no MANIFEST.json. Add one that lists its files.

manifestInvalid.doc: a manifest is not JSON, lacks a field, or names another package or schema major than its place

text.en: The manifest at {path} does not match the package it describes. Fix the field the detail names.

manifestMismatch.doc: a listed file is missing, a file is present but not listed, or its hash differs

text.en: The manifest at {path} and the files installed beside it disagree. Regenerate the manifest from what is actually installed.

schemaMajor.doc: a file's $schema is not the installed form of the reader's schema major

text.en: The file at {path} names a schema major this reader does not read. Install it under the major this reader expects.

schemaTooOld.doc: a file's requires.omx-contract-schema floor is above the reader's schema

text.en: The file at {path} needs a newer omx-contract schema than this reader has. Upgrade omx-contract, or lower the file's floor.

schemaFloorAbsent.doc: an installed file of a package other than omx-contract states no schema floor

text.en: The file at {path} states no omx-contract schema floor. Add a requires.omx-contract-schema entry.

schemaFloorUnderstated.doc: a file does not validate against the schema at its requires.omx-contract-schema floor, only against a newer one: the floor understates what it needs

text.en: The file at {path} needs a newer schema than the floor it states. Raise the floor to the version it actually needs.
The file at {path} does not parse as JSON. Fix its syntax.

fileInvalid.doc: a file breaks the schema or the kernel-file shape, an unknown key or word included

text.en: The file at {path} breaks the schema or the kernel-file shape. Fix the field the detail names.
{item} is declared by two files. Remove the duplicate so only one package declares it.

kernelDuplicate.doc: two packages each declare a file of one kernel

text.en: Kernel {kernel} is declared by two packages. Keep the declaration in one package only.
{ref} refers to a name no installed file declares. Install the file that declares it, or fix the reference.

refUndeclared.doc: a reference names an item of a package the file does not require

text.en: {ref} refers to an item of a package its file does not require. Add that package to requires.

verbDuplicate.doc: two verbs items, of one package or two, declare one verb: a verb has one owner

text.en: Verb {verb} is declared by more than one package or item. A verb has one owner: remove the extra declaration.

verbFormat.doc: a verb's format does not start with the verb it declares

text.en: Verb {verb}'s format does not start with the verb itself. Rename the format to start with {verb}.

verbHostUnknown.doc: a verb's implementedBy names a host that is no word of VERB_HOSTS

text.en: Verb {verb} names a host that is not a word of VERB_HOSTS. Add the host there, or fix the verb’s implementedBy.

verbCodeUnknown.doc: a verb's code names an item that is no codes item, or a name that item does not carry

text.en: Verb {verb} names a code no codes item carries. Fix the code name, or add it where the codes item declares its codes.

roleDuplicate.doc: two roleMeanings items, of one package or two, declare one role: a role has one owner

text.en: Role {role} is declared by more than one package or item. A role has one owner: remove the extra declaration.

packageAbsent.doc: a package the consumer or a file requires is not installed

text.en: {package} is required and is not installed. Install it beside the files that require it.

packageTooOld.doc: a required package is installed below its floor

text.en: {package} is installed below the version required of it. Upgrade it to the required version.

originMisplaced.doc: a scanned plugin descriptor is installed in the contract directory: a scan is never read as a declaration

text.en: A scanned plugin descriptor is installed in the contract directory at {path}. Remove it: a scan is never a declaration.

descriptorOriginSource.doc: an authored descriptor with no impl link, or a built or scanned one with a control that has no from link

text.en: {descriptor} has a control with no source link. An authored descriptor needs an impl link; a built or scanned one needs a from link on every control.

descriptorUnknownAuthored.doc: an authored descriptor with a unit, a scale or a meaning of unknown

text.en: {descriptor} is authored and leaves a control's unit, scale or meaning as unknown. State it, or mark the descriptor built or scanned instead.

descriptorControlDuplicate.doc: two controls of a descriptor with one id, one name or one symbol

text.en: {descriptor} declares two controls with the same id, name or symbol. Give each control its own.

descriptorEasy.doc: an easy list that names no control, names one twice or a hidden or read-only one, or stands in a scanned descriptor

text.en: {descriptor}'s easy list names no control, names one twice, names a hidden or read-only control, or appears in a scanned descriptor. Fix the easy list.

descriptorIntegrity.doc: an integrity block whose version is not the plugin's own, or on a plugin that states no version

text.en: {descriptor}'s integrity names another version than the plugin states. Regenerate the descriptor from the build it describes.

descriptorMeter.doc: a meter of a descriptor with the id or a symbol of another meter, a symbol a control answers to, a range whose min is not below its max, a scale that is no id of PARAM_SCALES, a unit the kind does not measure in (level: dBFS, dBTP, LUFS, LU; gain-reduction: dB), a measurement in a unit it is not measured in, or a clip word on a gain reduction or a true clip on a loudness

text.en: {descriptor} has a meter whose id, symbol, range, scale or unit is wrong for its kind. Fix the meter the detail names.

descriptorPortDuplicate.doc: two ports of a descriptor of one kind and direction with one id

text.en: {descriptor} declares two ports of the same kind and direction with one id. Give each port its own id.

descriptorRange.doc: a travel whose min is above its max, whose step is negative, or whose default lies outside it

text.en: {descriptor} has a travel whose min, max, step or default is out of order. Fix the travel the detail names.

descriptorChoice.doc: a choice whose default is not one of its ids, or whose labels or values are not one per id

text.en: {descriptor} has a choice whose default is not one of its ids, or whose labels or values do not match its ids one for one. Fix the choice the detail names.

descriptorScale.doc: a scale that is neither an id of PARAM_SCALES nor unknown

text.en: {descriptor} names a scale that is neither an id of PARAM_SCALES nor unknown. Fix the scale name, or add it to PARAM_SCALES.

descriptorPortWords.doc: a layout word on a port that is not audio, dialects off a note port or missing on one, or a layout its channels contradict

text.en: {descriptor} has a port whose layout, dialect or channel words contradict each other. Fix the port the detail names.

descriptorInstrument.doc: an instrument block without the instrument feature or the reverse, or an instrument with no note or MIDI input or no audio output

text.en: {descriptor} declares an instrument block without the instrument feature (or the reverse), or an instrument with no note or MIDI input or no audio output. Fix the instrument declaration.

descriptorWhen.doc: a when that names no choice of the descriptor, or an id that choice does not have

text.en: {descriptor} has a when that names no choice of the descriptor, or an id that choice does not have. Fix the when the detail names.

descriptorFaceDiffers.doc: a plugin's built face, scanned as a host scans it, states other than its authored descriptor; raised by the owner's face check, since the reader compares no faces

text.en: {descriptor}’s built face states other than what it is authored as. Update the authored descriptor, or fix the build.

overridePluginMismatch.doc: an override file whose plugin id or format is not the plugin it is applied to: the file is refused whole

text.en: The override at {path} names a plugin id or format other than the plugin it is applied to. The whole file is refused: fix which plugin it targets.

overrideControlAbsent.doc: an override entry that names a control the descriptor does not have: the entry is dropped

text.en: The override at {path} names a control the descriptor does not have. That entry is dropped: remove it, or fix the control name.

overrideWidens.doc: an override entry whose travel end lies outside the plugin's ends, or whose default lies outside the travel: the entry is dropped

text.en: The override at {path} has a travel end outside the plugin's ends, or a default outside the travel. That entry is dropped: bring it inside the plugin's own range.

overrideKindMismatch.doc: an override entry with a word that does not fit the control's kind (a travel or a map on a choice) or its family (a band without family eq and an EQ meaning): the entry is dropped

text.en: The override at {path} has a word that does not fit the control’s kind or family. That entry is dropped: fix the word, or the control it is applied to.

overrideScaleFloor.doc: an override entry with a log scale over a floor that is not positive: the entry is dropped

text.en: The override at {path} sets a log scale over a floor that is not positive. That entry is dropped: use a positive floor.

overrideMapInvalid.doc: an override map that is not strictly monotonic, does not cover the plugin's ends or lies outside them: the entry is dropped

text.en: The override at {path} has a map that is not strictly monotonic, or does not cover the plugin’s ends. That entry is dropped: fix the map.

overrideBasisEvidence.doc: an override entry with basis measured and no evidence, or evidence with another basis: the entry is dropped

text.en: The override at {path} states basis measured with no evidence, or evidence with another basis. That entry is dropped: add the matching evidence, or change the basis.

overrideFingerprintDiffers.doc: an override file written against another control list than the descriptor's: a warning, the entries that still hold are applied

text.en: The override at {path} was written against another control list than the descriptor's. The entries that still fit are applied; review the rest.

sourceAbsent.doc: a link's path does not exist

text.en: The path a link names, {path}, does not exist. Fix the link's path.

sourceSymbolAbsent.doc: the path holds no definition of the link's symbol

text.en: {path} holds no definition of the symbol a link names. Fix the symbol name, or point the link elsewhere.

sourceAmbiguous.doc: the path defines the link's symbol more than once

text.en: {path} defines the symbol a link names more than once. Make the definition unique, or narrow the link.

sourceDiffers.doc: the value at a from link is not the declared value

text.en: The value at {path}'s from link is not the value declared beside it. Update the declared value to match, or fix the link.

sourceUnevaluable.doc: a from link whose value the tool cannot read

text.en: The value at {path}'s from link cannot be read by this tool. Simplify the source, or state the value by hand and drop the link.

sourceUnread.doc: an impl link whose definition does not name the item

text.en: The definition at {path}'s impl link does not name the item it is linked from. Point the link at the definition that actually names it.

sourceNone.doc: an item with no impl link, where every item must carry one

text.en: {item} carries no impl link, and every item of its kind must carry one. Add the link to where it is defined.
